origins.name: Caravan Hand
origins.description: You learned to read a trail before you learned to read a book.

origins.name: Vault Exile
origins.description: The door closed behind you. The old world's secrets did not.

origins.name: Scrap Prospector
origins.description: There is a living buried in the ruins. Sometimes it still moves.

archetypes.name: Gunslinger
archetypes.description: A steady hand in an unsteady world.

archetypes.name: Warden
archetypes.description: Stand between the caravan and whatever comes out of the dark.

archetypes.name: Tinker
archetypes.description: Old machines have a language. You know how to make them listen.

archetypes.name: Ash Preacher
archetypes.description: Carry a little faith through a country that has lost its gods.

destinations.name: Mercy Crossing
destinations.description: A water tower, a trading post, and a promise nobody remembers making. Your caravan's last safe berth.

destinations.name: Blackwire Pass
destinations.description: The old relay line climbs into broken country. Scouts report movement above the road. A local area is available to explore.

destinations.name: Saint's Relay
destinations.description: A dead transmission tower still sends a signal at dusk. Rusting antennae rise above a fenced maintenance yard.

destinations.name: The Salt Graves
destinations.description: White earth. Black markers. No names. A pale salt flat surrounds rows of weathered burial crosses and a solitary memorial.

destinations.name: Forest Crossroads
destinations.description: Four old roads meet beneath the trees. A woodland trail leads to an abandoned caravan camp.

destinations.name: Abandoned Quarry
destinations.description: Broken stone shelves rise above the quarry floor. Two routes wind past exposed seams and a deserted work yard.

destinations.name: Forgotten Graveyard
destinations.description: Burial rows and broken fences surround a silent memorial. A woodland trail skirts the graves.
